title: kissed with velvety portuguese dish bowl
description: grassy, velvety, indulgent portuguese dish featuring red pepper flakes and bhuna, served in a korean brass bowl

ingredients.name: gluten-free soy sauce
ingredients.notes: made with rice vinegar and gluten-free soybeans

instructions: in a small bowl, whisk together korean chili flakes, bhuna curry paste, and 1 tsp of coconut cream to make the sauce
in a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of gluten-free soy sauce over medium heat, then add sliced red onion and cook for 5 minutes
add grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
add sliced red bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes, stirring frequently
add grated carrot and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally
stir in coconut cream and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through
season with salt and pepper to taste
transfer the mixture to a korean brass bowl and top with mixed greens, then drizzle with the sauce
